name: DS Cluster S10d: Upsample by Interpolate
description: Tests: upsample_by_interpolate with FillDirection.forward/backward/both on monthly CPI → daily.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S10d: Upsample by Interpolate
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
cpi_raw = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.CPI)().result

# === ALL limit_direction= VARIANTS ===
interp_fwd = upsample_by_interpolate(target_timeframe=1D, limit_direction=FillDirection.forward)(cpi_raw)
interp_bwd = upsample_by_interpolate(target_timeframe=1D, limit_direction=FillDirection.backward)(cpi_raw)
interp_both = upsample_by_interpolate(target_timeframe=1D, limit_direction=FillDirection.both)(cpi_raw)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="CPI Interpolate: forward vs backward vs both",
    category="Interpolate",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Forward", color=Color.Cyan),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Backward", color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Both", color=Color.White)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(interp_fwd, interp_bwd, interp_both))
